name: datasheet-rag-mcp
description: Search and navigate a multi-scale RAG database of electronics datasheets and reference manuals.
long_description:
Exposes a multi-scale RAG store of electronics datasheets as MCP tools: hybrid (BM25 + dense vector) search, hierarchical chunk navigation, figure retrieval, inline PDF page rendering, and document metadata lookup.

Two modes, chosen by configuration:
• Local — opens a SQLite database on this machine directly (set the SQLite Database Path). Embeddings/figures are read from the local store.
• Remote — talks to a shared datasheet-rag server over HTTP (set the Server URL and, if the server requires it, an Access Token). The server owns the database, embedder, figures, and PDFs; nothing local is needed. This mirrors how the CLI selects its backend.

If a Server URL is set it takes precedence (remote mode); otherwise the extension runs in local mode against the SQLite path.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Hybrid (BM25 + dense vector), keyword-only, or vector-only search over RAG chunks

tools.name: get_chunk
tools.description: Fetch a single chunk by ID, optionally including its neighbours

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Step through the chunk graph: parent, children, prev, next, or chapter_root

tools.name: zoom_in
tools.description: Get finer-grained child chunks (macro → meso, meso → micro)

tools.name: zoom_out
tools.description: Get the parent chunk for broader context (micro → meso, meso → macro)

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in the current project, optionally filtered by group/MPN/manufacturer

tools.name: get_document_metadata
tools.description: Fetch the metadata sidecar for a document (MPN, manufacturer, tags, subsystem)

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Return chunk counts (total and by level) for the current scope

tools.name: get_figure
tools.description: Fetch the image for a figure chunk and return it for the user to see

tools.name: show_pdf
tools.description: Open the source PDF for a document in an interactive scrollable viewer (Claude Desktop)

server_url.title: Server URL (remote mode)
server_url.description: Base URL of a shared datasheet-rag server, e.g. https://rag.internal:8080. Set this to use REMOTE mode — the server owns the database, embedder, figures, and PDFs, and the fields below (SQLite path, S3 bucket, AWS region) are not needed. Leave blank to use LOCAL mode.

server_token.title: Access Token (remote mode)
server_token.description: Bearer token sent to the remote server, if it requires authentication (RAG_SERVER_TOKEN — a read or ingest key). Leave blank for an open/trusted-LAN server or for local mode.

db_path.title: SQLite Database Path (local mode)
db_path.description: Path to the RAG SQLite database file (e.g. output/rag.sqlite in your project directory). Required for LOCAL mode; ignored when a Server URL is set.

s3_bucket.title: S3 Bucket (local mode)
s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket name used for PDF storage and Textract output (RAG_S3_BUCKET). Only used in local mode; ignored when a Server URL is set.

aws_region.title: AWS Region (local mode)
aws_region.description: AWS region for Bedrock and S3 (e.g. eu-west-1). Only used in local mode.

default_project_id.title: Default Project ID
default_project_id.description: Scope all tool calls to this project by default. Leave blank to search globally.

figures_dir.title: Figures Directory (local mode)
figures_dir.description: Directory holding cropped figure PNGs. Used in local mode to serve images over a loopback HTTP server so Claude Desktop can render them inline (file:// is blocked by the renderer). Leave blank to use <db_path parent>/figures. Ignored in remote mode — figures are fetched from the server.
